searchText: theory about what? this server is active ethereum research & development. if something doesn't fit in an existing channel, it might be better in a different server While Ethereum focuses on the State (Verkle), the ecosystem is increasingly looking for ways to manage Data (Prolly/CMTs). Cartesian Merkle Trees (CMTs) and Prolly Trees If a developer needs to prove that "User A has a balance between 10 and 50 tokens," Cartesian Merkle Trees (CMTs) are incredibly efficient at "range queries." Verkle trees are optimized for single-point lookups but can be bulkier for complex, ordered logic. Unlike Verkle Trees, which focus on proving data is correct, TEASL focuses on finding it 85% faster. It is an academic indexing technique that maps historical block data into a searchable ternary tree without duplicating data or requiring massive storage overhead.
